post.originalText:
I asked Claude Opus 5.5 for "an Apple-style 30s video of my app" in one prompt.

It wrote the whole film in code (Remotion + React): SF Pro type, a titanium iPhone, captions synced word-by-word to real voice, even the music.
#Claude 
This is Matra, Gujarati captions in one tap👇 https://t.co/ZMNUqPFcuB
